fullTitle: api: /sessions /:token DELETE should log the action in the audit log if it is a field key
reason: The upstream fixture expects app-user creation to return a legacy long-lived field-key session token. VG creation deliberately returns no token; callers must authenticate with the short-lived username/password bearer flow.

fullTitle: api: /sessions /:token DELETE should allow managers to delete project app user sessions
reason: The upstream fixture reads body.token from app-user creation. VG creation deliberately does not expose a long-lived field-key session token.

fullTitle: api: /sessions /:token DELETE should not allow app users to delete their own sessions
reason: The upstream fixture reads body.token from app-user creation. VG app-user sessions are issued only as short-lived login bearers and are not returned by create.

fullTitle: api: /sessions /:token DELETE should log the action in the audit log for app users
reason: The upstream fixture expects a long-lived app-user field-key token from create so it can end that session. VG create returns no token under the secure contract.

fullTitle: api: /sessions /current DELETE should not allow app users to delete their own sessions
reason: The upstream fixture reads appUser.token from create. VG app-user creation never exposes a long-lived session token; login returns only a short-lived bearer.

fullTitle: api: /projects/:id/app-users POST should create a long session
reason: VG app-user login deliberately issues a short-lived bearer session rather than the upstream effectively permanent field-key session.

fullTitle: api: /projects/:id/app-users POST should log the action in the audit log
reason: VG secure app-user creation uses the namespaced vg.app_user.create audit action rather than the upstream field_key.create action.

fullTitle: api: /projects/:id/app-users /:id DELETE should log the action in the audit log
reason: VG secure app-user creation uses the namespaced vg.app_user.create audit action, so the upstream field_key.create audit is intentionally absent.

fullTitle: project viewer role should be able to download submissions
reason: VG submission exports require the explicit submission.export verb; the upstream Project Viewer fixture grants submission.read only.
